title: Kestrel Robotics raises $9M Series A
subject: Kestrel Robotics
document:
PITTSBURGH, June 10, 2026 — Kestrel Robotics, maker of autonomous rebar-tying systems, today announced a $9 million Series A led by Ironbridge Ventures, with participation from Keystone Capital. The round brings total funding to $12.5 million. Kestrel's robots are deployed with several of the largest US heavy civil contractors. "We see a path to every bridge deck in America," said CEO Maya Lindqvist. The company employs 18 people and plans to double its team by next year.
